Configuration: course title, course code, short description, detailed description, learning objectives, difficulty level, estimated duration, mandatory status (all employee / role / division / department / function etc.) tags, keywords, version number, expiry date, course thumbnail (image / video), module-wise thumbnail (image / video), sub-title management (English and bangla)
Basic course structure: organize course -> module (section) -> lesson (activity) -> feedback -> assessment -> certification

Learning rules: sequential learning, conditional access to next content (mandatory completion), completion criteria, minimum score, pass mark, time limit, course expiry, auto re-enrollment, refresher interval etc.

Content type: video, SCORM package, zip, youtube video, streaming link, PDF, .doc, PPT, excel, image with protection options (preview only / download allowed / print allowed / water mark etc.) as well as interactive contents HTML5, H5P, image comparison, bangla language content / UI support, closed caption / subtitles for videos etc. Offline and low-bandwith playback support is also needed. etc.
Content support: drag & drop, uploader, reordering etc.

Content control: playback speed, allow / disallow speed control, allow / disallow skipping, prevent forward seeking, resume from last watch position, picture-in-picture, full screen, tracking mechanism: watch percentage, page scrolled, time spent, interoperable learning-activity tracking (xAPI/cmi5) etc.

Assessment: embedded assessment – before activity, during activity, end of activity and after a certain pre-defined time (details of the assessment functionalities is discussed in the Assessment / Exam Module)
Feedback: activity-level feedback, course-level feedback (details of the feedback functionalities is discussed in the Feedback Module), overall course rating etc.

Certification: configurable by admin, multiple templets can be created, digital signature, auto-generated upon course completion / criteria completion, QR code verification, download (image, pdf), share (email, social media platforms)
Learning path: category assign, sequence to multiple courses, pre-requisites, role-based learning, mandatory learning etc.

Enrollment: individual enrollment, bulk upload (excel-based, excel cells drag & drop), role-wise admin enrollment, grade / role / branch / division / department / location-wise enrollment, enrollment request by trainee, create batch and scheduling with criteria during enrollment, external learner profile creation (individual / bulk) etc.

Notification & communication: Configurable reminder frequency, automated enrollment notifications with customized email, course due and overdue reminders (web, in-app and email) to trainee, manager alerts for team progress / overdue course and assessment, feedback request reminders, automated certificate to trainee's designated email, announcement center, email / SMS / push notification / whatsapp integration support etc.
Version control: with or without uploading new course / content assigning to trainees as fresh course; with previous data backup, archive and restore functionality
Search: global search, filter by division / department / office / region / difficulty / popularity / grade / designation etc.
Direct access to course from the shared link after logging in.

Trainee dashboard: course-wise completion status, last viewed course, bookmarks, downloads, discussion forum, learning goal / KPI & progress, upcoming exam, latest exam results, leaderboard for the completed exams, certificates, upcoming schedules (exam, training, course etc.), calendar view of the assigned tasks, course enrolled – completed / upcoming – hours, exam enrolled - completed / pending, progress bar, points / badges / star / rewards etc.
Manager dashboard: all as the trainee and learning goal / KPI & progress of the reportees, Absent / course non-completion report of the reportees etc.

Reports: course-wise completion and assessment result, year & course-wise completion and assessment results, year & branch-wise reports, trainee's individual training report, branch / division / department-wise report, topic-wise report, tag-wise report, gender-wise report, training / course category-wise report, medium-wise report etc.
Separate dashboards and analytics for trainings, e-learning, exam, feedback etc.
Integration of AI tools to identify employees at risk of missing mandatory compliance deadlines, or forecasting division-level skill gaps before they become a performance problem
Direct access to exam from the shared link after logging in.
Question type: MCQ, true/false, fill in blank, short answer (bound by character number), essay, case study, Image MCQ / case study, matching, drag & drop etc.

Exam Configuration: Exam title, instructions, reading material attachment, passing score, mark for each question setting, negative marking, question randomization, option shuffle within question, question bank upload, time limit, attempt limit, exam availability, exam proctoring (webcam, face verification against EID photo, window / browser restriction, tab switch detection, copy-paste restriction, gaze count etc.), auto submit upon time limit exceeds, grace time, no of questions in display, pop-up message when a participant leaves / submits exam without answering all the questions, individual enrollment, bulk upload (excel-based, excel cells drag & drop), role-wise admin enrollment, grade / role / branch / division / department / location-wise enrollment etc.

Exam evaluation: automatic (MCQ, Fill in the blanks, true/false), manual and AI assistance (for descriptive answers), trainer assignment (for descriptive questions – both question wise and exam wise), plagiarism detection etc.
Result setting: Instant / scheduled, with whole questions, with / without correct answer, Score / percentage display, Grade setting (Excellent, Very Good etc.) etc.
Question pull: from questions uploaded under specific exam, from one / multiple question bank, difficulty level wise etc.

Question Bank: topic-wise (folders), question category (mandatory to pull or not), difficulty level, tags, single / bulk upload (excel), bulk download (topic / category / question bank-wise), duplicate detection, random question generation, question expiry, count of type-wise question under question bank, multiple exams using same question banks / topics etc.

Dashboard: exam tagging with scheduled training, participation rate, pending participation, edit exam, exam summary (nos enrolled, nos participated), graphical presentation of different reports / results, participants can download individual exam wise excel report, exam results / participation status of reportees in the manager's dashboard etc.

Notification & communication: Configurable reminder frequency, automated enrollment notifications with customized email, exam due and overdue reminders (web, in-app and email) to trainee, manager alerts for team progress / overdue exam, feedback request reminders, email / SMS / push notification / whatsapp integration support etc
'Star Icon' for top scorer, Gallery option to show top exam performer's pictures and details.
